Adoption Notice of CCSDS 232.0-B-4, TC Space Data Link Protocol
short_title: ECSS Adoption Notice of CCSDS 232.0-B-4 (TC SDLP)
organisation: ECSS Secretariat, ESA-ESTEC Requirements & Standards Section (prepared by the ECSS Space Communications Working Group)
status_notes: ECSS-E-AS-50-25C Rev.1 of 13 January 2023 is 'First issue, Revision 1' and replaces the 1 March 2021 first issue (change log, p. 3). The first issue, together with ECSS-E-AS-50-24C and ECSS-E-AS-50-26C, replaces ECSS-E-ST-50-04C (change log p. 3; context p. 6). Whether a later revision exists is not stated in the document.

contents.title: Packet Assembly Controller Function (new clause inside Table 4-1)
Interfaces for Space Data Link Security (SDLS)

key_points.text: Requirement ECSS-E-AS-50-25_1560001 makes CCSDS 232.0-B-4, TC Space Data Link Protocol, Issue 4, October 2021 applicable with the modifications of Table 4-1.
Clause 4.1.1b is modified so that the Transfer Frame Data Field is up to 1017 octets (the CCSDS option of 1019 octets is deleted).
The Frame Error Control Field (2 octets) is made mandatory: 4.1.1c is changed from optional to mandatory and 4.1.4.1.1 and 4.1.4.1.3 are deleted.

The CLCW No Bit Lock Flag is no longer optional: '0' when at least one spacecraft demodulation unit for the physical channel has bit lock, '1' when none has; it always reports the actual physical channel status.
New clause 4.4.9 adds the Packet Assembly Controller Function, usable by MAP Packet Extraction and MAP Reception to reassemble Packets or MAP_SDUs; the name is inherited from earlier standards.
Each Packet Assembly Controller instance uses a pair of 6-bit MAP Identifiers: a data MAP (MSB 0, range 0 to 31) and a control MAP equal to the data MAP + 32.

The function keeps a reassembly status flag ('1' while reconstruction is in progress) and enters a lockout state on an incorrect sequence of Sequence Flags or an invalid control segment; eight illegal sequence-flag transitions are listed.
The function reports the data MAP ID, reassembly status flag and lockout status flag to the sending end, but the format and transport of that status are not specified.

A control segment is one octet long (Segment Header only) with Sequence Flags '11' and a control-MAP identifier; a valid control segment is a MAP Reset command, which discards a partial packet and exits lockout.
Managed-parameter Table 5-1 (Presence of Frame Error Control: Present only) and Table 5-4 (Maximum Frame Data Unit Length: up to 1017) are modified accordingly.
Clause 6.3.7 (SDLS) is modified so that the FECF always follows the Security Trailer, or the Data Field when there is no trailer.

Annex A notes that, unlike ECSS-E-ST-50-04C, CCSDS 232.0-B-4 offers formal service interfaces, optional SDLS, normative managed parameters (formerly 'mission configuration parameters' in Annex E of ECSS-E-ST-50-04) and a normative PICS.

notes: Adoption notices contain no normative-references clause; the adopted CCSDS 232.0-B-4 is listed above as 'normative' because requirement ECSS-E-AS-50-25_1560001 makes it applicable (p. 8). The bibliography (p. 23) prints ECSS-E-AS-50-23C Rev.1 as 'Adoption Notice of CCSDS 232.0-B-4, AOS Space Data Link Protocol', an apparent typo for CCSDS 732.0-B-x (the context table on p. 6 maps ECSS-E-AS-50-23 to CCSDS 732.0-B-x). The change log (p. 3) says Rev.1 'adds a protocol implementation conformance statement proforma as new normative Annex A', but this document's Annex A is the informative 'Differences from ECSS-E-ST-50-04C'; the PICS meant is Annex A of CCSDS 232.0-B-4 itself (p. 22). The scope text runs '232.0-B-4TC' together (p. 5). The comment on the Table 5-4 row says 'Table 5-1' (p. 19). The registry gives 23 pages, while srcgrep shows 24 PDF pages (the last one is blank). Printed page numbers equal PDF page numbers.
